arguments.query: select order_ts, status from orders limit 3
select i.unit_price_cents, i.quantity, p.list_price_twd from order_items i join products p using(product_id) limit 5
select r.refund_amount_twd, r.item_id, r.order_id, r.refund_ts from refunds r limit 5

select (select sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0 from orders o join order_items i using(order_id) join products p using(product_id) where p.category='backpack' and o.status in (1,2,3) and datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')>='2025-01-01' and datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')<'2026-01-01') as gross, (select sum(r.refund_amount_twd) from refunds r join order_items i using(item_id) join products p using(product_id) join orders o on o.order_id=i.order_id where p.category='backpack' and o.status in (1,2,3) and datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')>='2025-01-01' and datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')<'2026-01-01') as refunds, (select count(*) from refunds r left join order_items i using(item_id) where i.item_id is null or i.order_id<>r.order_id) as orphan
